key_insight: Hilbert–Schmidt asymmetry guides variational quantum optimization toward a target symmetry sector without requiring symmetry-preserving preparation circuits.
engineering_relevance: Symmetry-based guidance can improve VQE energy accuracy and ground-state fidelity while retaining flexible hardware-efficient ansatzes.
method: Quantify deviation from symmetry using quantum-accessible Hilbert–Schmidt asymmetry.
Use asymmetry to guide optimization toward the target symmetry sector.
Test collective SU(2) symmetry guidance for singlet ground-state calculations.
evidence_signal: Proof-of-principle tests on a five-qubit nuclear two-cluster Hamiltonian and collective spin models with up to 12 particles increased singlet probability and improved energy accuracy and fidelity relative to direct energy minimization.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish scalability beyond 12 particles or quantify measurement overhead and robustness to hardware noise.
paper_title: Symmetry-guided algorithms for variational quantum optimization
